description: This file contains an implementation of the ExternalMessage interface, namely the UnmodifiableExternalMessage class, which is used for representing read-only external messages with various payloads, headers, and metadata in a Java-based connectivity model.

classes.name: UnmodifiableExternalMessage
classes.description: A final class implementing ExternalMessage that encapsulates message data in an immutable and thread-safe manner, intended for message transmission without modification.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable map of message headers.

methods.name: withHeader
methods.description: Returns a new ExternalMessage with an additional header specified by key and value.

methods.name: withHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new ExternalMessage with multiple additional headers.

methods.name: withTopicPath
methods.description: Returns a new ExternalMessage with the specified topic path.

methods.name: findHeader
methods.description: Searches for a header by key, case-sensitive, returning an Optional of its value if present and non-empty.

methods.name: findHeaderIgnoreCase
methods.description: Searches headers for a key matching the given key ignoring case, returning the first match.

methods.name: isTextMessage
methods.description: Checks if the payload type indicates a text message.

methods.name: isBytesMessage
methods.description: Checks if the payload type indicates a bytes message.

methods.name: getTextPayload
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the text payload if present.

methods.name: getBytePayload
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the byte buffer payload if present.

methods.name: getPayloadType
methods.description: Returns the payload type of the message.

methods.name: isResponse
methods.description: Indicates whether the message is a response.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Indicates whether the message represents an error.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the authorization context if present.

methods.name: getTopicPath
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the topic path if present.

methods.name: getEnforcementFilter
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the enforcement filter if set.

methods.name: getHeaderMapping
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the header mapping if available.

methods.name: getPayloadMapping
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the payload mapping if available.

methods.name: getSourceAddress
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the source address if present.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the source object if present.

methods.name: getInternalHeaders
methods.description: Returns the internal DittoHeaders object associated with this message.
